summary: 4/4 UI-facing criteria verified via browser checks. No API-bearing criteria (privacy content is static per spec_deviations). No regressions found on /login.

checks.criterion: Public privacy policy page exists for Google OAuth consent screen
checks.name: privacy-page-public-access
checks.evidence: Navigated to /privacy without auth (also re-verified against https://marhaba-preview-4.preview.emergentagent.com). data-testid=privacy-page visible, title='سياسة الخصوصية', privacy-section count=5, page text contains 'drive.file' and '09-08'. No redirect to /login.

checks.name: privacy-page-trilingual
checks.evidence: On /privacy, clicked lang-option-fr -> title 'Politique de confidentialité'; clicked lang-option-en -> title 'Privacy policy'.

checks.name: login-links-to-privacy
checks.evidence: On /login, data-testid=login-privacy-link visible; click navigates to /privacy and privacy-page is visible. (Benign 401 console message from unauthenticated /api/me probe, expected on public page.)

checks.name: login-page-no-regression
checks.evidence: On /login, login-google-button visible and contains 'Google' text; login-wordmark visible; password form (PasswordForm component) rendered. Only console message is expected 401 from unauthenticated /api/me check, no app errors.

notes: Matrix had 4 criteria total, all UI-facing; no backend test files added since no criterion depends on an API endpoint (privacy content is static, per spec_deviations).
One check (privacy-page-public-access) was additionally re-run against the public preview URL https://marhaba-preview-4.preview.emergentagent.com and passed.
